assertion_analysis.failure_condition: assert composed[SHIM_PYTHON_ENV] == sys.executable fails if _persisted_worker_environment stops writing RECKON_SHIM_PYTHON; the right-hand side is the interpreter running the test, independent of anything the test hands the code, and the declared negative control (renaming the module constant) reddens it exactly, recorded in negative-control.log.

assert kept[SHIM_PYTHON_ENV] == chosen fails if the composer overwrites a value the caller already supplied; chosen is the value passed in, but the guarded defect (an unconditional assignment to sys.executable) is precisely an overwrite of the pass-through, so the assertion reddens on the regression even though both sides name the same literal.

assert STUB_MARKER not in result.stderr fails if the shim resolves the stub python3.12 rather than the composing interpreter; the marker is emitted only by the planted stub, an independent artefact of the run, and negative-control.log shows it reddening with 'STUB-PYTHON3.12-RAN'.

assert result.returncode == 0 and 'TOOL=srun' in result.stdout fail if the shim dies before reaching reckon.nested_launch.main or forwards nothing; TOOL=srun is printed by the planted fake srun, independent of the composed environment.
